commands.command:
set -eu
cd /srv/legacy2/incremental-archive-chain
mkdir recovered
tar -xf base.tar -C recovered
for a in day2.tar day3.tar; do
  stage=`mktemp -d /tmp/incremental-stage.XXXXXX`
  tar -xf "$a" -C "$stage"
  rm -f "$stage/deletions.txt"
  cp -a "$stage/." recovered/
  tar -xOf "$a" deletions.txt | while IFS= read -r p; do
    case "$p" in
      ''|/*|.|..|../*|*/../*|*/..) printf '%s\n' "unsafe deletion path in $a: $p" >&2; exit 1 ;;
    esac
    rm -rf -- "recovered/$p"
  done
  rm -rf -- "$stage"
done
printf '%s\n' 'reconstruction complete'
find recovered -type f -print | LC_ALL=C sort
